name: Prism 00 - Tenant Context Resolver
description: Shared multi-tenant context resolver for all Prism services. Resolves decrypted tokens, entitlements, and orgConfig (Zoho datacenter, org IDs, Dynamics URL) server-side via the Supabase Edge Function prism-connector-context; falls back to request-supplied

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ organizationId: $json.organizationId || null, userId: $json.userId || null, connectorId: $json.connectorId || null }) }}

parameters.content:
## Prism 00 - Tenant Context Resolver
Every service calls this with {organizationId, userId, connectorId, supabaseUrl, fallback context}.
Server-resolves tokens/entitlements/orgConfig via Edge Function `prism-connector-context`; falls back to request-supplied context on any failure (hybrid mode).
Output: {contextSource, accessToken, enabled, entitlement, orgConfig, organizationId, userId, connectorId, diagnostics}.
Configure the org Supabase URL per tenant via the `supabaseUrl` input - deploy the Edge Function from docs/SUPABASE_PRISM_V2_PROMPTS.md to enable server-side mode.
